title: Human-like session: build an InMemoryStore in three turns
description: Three scripted human turns build an InMemoryStore incrementally: turn 1 adds set/get, turn 2 adds delete/has, turn 3 adds keys and runs the full test suite. Tests for all five methods are provided upfront so grading drives progression across turns.

task_spec.prompt: Implement the `set(key, value)` and `get(key, default=None)` methods of InMemoryStore in store.py. Use `self._data` (the dict already provided in __init__). Do not change any other method yet.
followup_prompts: Good. Now implement `delete(key)` — remove the key from self._data and return True if it existed, False if it didn't. Also implement `has(key)` which returns True if the key is in self._data.
Now implement `keys()` so it returns all current keys (e.g. return self._data.keys()). Then run `pytest test_store.py -v --rootdir=.` to verify all 12 tests pass and fix any remaining failures.
success_criteria: has checks presence without side effects
